# Other methods on grouped views, DICES-350 (generated by scripts/dices_group_methods.py)

Accuracy (%) against the expert label. Dev = 174 conversations used to tune FUSE, test = 176 held out. Group votes: a group says unsafe when more than half its raters did.

## Per rater (reference)

| Method | Dev | Test | All 350 | Test AUC | Called unsafe % | Test − per-rater MV (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Majority vote, per rater | 64.9 | 65.3 | 65.1 | 80.0 | 23 | +0.0 [+0.0, +0.0] |
| Dawid–Skene, per rater | 66.1 | 71.0 | 68.6 | 80.6 | 33 | +5.7 [+0.6, +10.8] |
